changes.oldText: Users can switch between projects using the project selector provided in the top bar. By default, the project that the user currently belongs to is selected. Since each project may have different resource policies, switching projects may also change the available resource policies.
changes.newText: Users can switch between projects using the project selector provided in the top bar. By default, the project that the user currently belongs to is selected. You can access your personal project by selecting My Project. Since each project may have different resource policies, switching projects may also change the available resource policies.
